credit.credit-words: The King Shall Come When Morning Dawns
WORDS: Unknown Greek author; tr. by John Brownlie, 1907. MUSIC: “Goshen/Jerusalem”; German melody, pub.1789; arr. attr. to Charles H. Purday. Public Domain.

This same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven. Ac. 1:11 As the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be. Mt. 24:27
